description: This file is a shell script that functions as a helper for launching diff and merge tools compatible with git difftool and mergetool. It manages prompts, determines which merge tool to invoke, and handles external command execution for merging and diffing files within a git workflow.

methods.name: should_prompt
methods.description: Determines whether the diff tool should prompt before launching, based on git configuration and environment variables.

methods.name: use_ext_cmd
methods.description: Checks if an external command was specified for the diff/merge operation.

methods.name: launch_merge_tool
methods.description: Handles the process of launching the merge tool with the specified files, with prompting logic and external command execution.
